title: RFE Creator Agent Result
description: Structured output from the rfe-creator agent, validated by the harness before the post-script runs.

type.description: Resolved work-item type (rfe, initiative, ...); none when skipped.

pipeline.description: Generic skill that ran (e.g. rfe-create, rfe-auto-fix, rfe-review); none when skipped.

items_created.description: Work items of `type` created in this run.

items_reviewed.description: Work items of `type` reviewed in this run.

items_submitted.description: Work items of `type` submitted in this run.

items_split.description: Work items of `type` split in this run.
